document_context: Rent prices are already regulated in favour of tenants due to existing laws and the rent index. In view of the high prices for buying flats with existing rent contracts, these are an unattractive investment. Even if one might think that additional rent control is needed besides the current tenant protection, one should not deny longstanding owners the opportunity to adjust their returns to market level. A cap on rent increases upon tenant change is therefore not to be supported.
span_a: Rent prices are already regulated in favour of tenants
span_b: due to existing laws and the rent index.

document_context: Dog dirt on the pavement requires my complete, ground-focused attention on my way to work. This results in a lack of alertness in the road traffic comparable to a minor offense of the traffic regulations. That's why causing such obstacles must to be more urgently punished. Dog owners may think that dog dirt is only a harmless secretion of an animal like any other. Yet then they misjudge its impact on road traffic.
span_a: Dog dirt on the pavement requires my complete, ground-focused attention on my way to work.
span_b: This results in a lack of alertness in the road traffic comparable to a minor offense of the traffic regulations.

document_context: Pieces of dog poo on the pavements are a real danger. Time and again children or the elderly slip on them. A fine for leaving dog waste behind admittedly seems rather authoritarian, but similar rules are often in place for bicycles on park paths, after all. Increasing penalties is therefore the right way. A dog dirt-free city will be more attractive not only for its residents but also for tourists!
span_a: Increasing penalties is therefore the right way.
span_b: A dog dirt-free city will be more attractive not only for its residents but also for tourists!

document_context: Actually it would be justified if all German universities charged tuition fees. As long as it is ensured that the funds really benefit the universities directly, one can continue to regard this as social justice. Those who study later decide this early on, anyway. It's always possible to take out a student loan or to earn a scholarship. To oblige non-academics to finance others' degrees through taxes, however, is not just.
span_a: As long as it is ensured that the funds really benefit the universities directly,
span_b: one can continue to regard this as social justice.

document_context: Secret services must be more tightly regulated in order to prevent excessive surveillance. After all, secret services tend to develop a life of their own (a state within a state), which would be irresponsible for democratic states. Besides, intelligence services intervene massively in the privacy of citizens and must therefore be monitored more closely to prevent abuse. Parliamentary control however hampers the work of intelligence services for it jeopardizes the secrecy and security of confidential data and informants.
span_a: Secret services must be more tightly regulated
span_b: in order to prevent excessive surveillance.

document_context: Energy saving light bulbs contain a significant amount of toxins. A commercially available bulb may contain for example up to five milligrams of mercury. That's why they should be taken off the market, unless they're unbreakable. But precisely this is unfortunately not the case.
span_a: Energy saving light bulbs contain a significant amount of toxins.
span_b: A commercially available bulb may contain for example up to five milligrams of mercury.

document_context: Schweinsteiger has now been injured for three days. We urgently need a midfield replacement for the coming match. The doctor was able to sign him off as fit for play with enough painkillers, but that would only make the injury worse in the long run. And a young substitute always invigorates the team.
span_a: Schweinsteiger has now been injured for three days.
span_b: We urgently need a midfield replacement for the coming match.

document_context: Olympic events are rooted in old traditions. On the other hand, the events have a culturally determined character. Our society is strongly digitized and influenced by computers. Yet sports are usually associated with physical training. Since however skat, chess etc. are not accepted as Olympic events, computer games should also not be recognized as Olympic events.
span_a: Olympic events are rooted in old traditions.
span_b: On the other hand, the events have a culturally determined character.
